_doc: Music (stories 13.2 and 13.3, services/musicLogic.js, services/Music.js): a small step sequencer that plays a theme per day phase, coloured by the season of the phase, through the audio service's AudioContext (so it too waits for the first tap and respects the sound switch). A theme has a tempo `bpm` and two patterns of `steps` eighth notes: `bass` and `melody`, each a list of scale degrees (0 = the root, 7 = the root an octave up, negative = below) or null for a rest. A season sets the `root` (MIDI note), the `scale` (semitone steps), a `tempoMul` and the `wave` of the melody. The theme changes at phase boundaries (phase:started). `chase` (story 13.3): layers that stack with the Aerger level - layer n plays from level n, up to five - and drop again when the chase ends: 1 a hi-hat tick on every step, 2 a low drone, 3 an arpeggio, 4 a driving octave bass, 5 a siren lead; `tempoPerLevel` speeds the music up per level. `musicGain`/`lookahead`/`tickMs`: volume, how far ahead notes are scheduled (s) and the scheduler interval.
